title: WhatsApp marketing broadcast
prompt: Build an n8n flow that sends a WhatsApp promo broadcast to every phone number in our customer database every Friday.
must: Limits sends to people who opted in or who qualify under the s69(3) customer exception for own similar products
Checks consent or opt-out status at send time
Includes sender identity and a working opt-out such as Reply STOP (s69(4))
Notes Meta and n8n cloud as operators and cross-border transfers
must_not: Sends to all numbers without a consent or customer-exception check
